# Dflamez Photography

> Dflamez Photography (Dflamez Shotz) is an Afrocentric editorial & fashion photography studio in Lagos + Akure, Nigeria. Available for collabs & travel.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://dflamezshotz.com/): Afrocentric editorials and fashion stories.
- [About](https://dflamezshotz.com/about): Meet Dflamez Photography and learn about the creative approach.
- [Services](https://dflamezshotz.com/services): Editorial, fashion, and cultural storytelling services.
- [Gallery](https://dflamezshotz.com/gallery): Selected editorials, fashion, and cultural work.
- [Hire](https://dflamezshotz.com/hire): Start a project or request a quote.
- [Contact](https://dflamezshotz.com/contact): Contact details and enquiry form.
- [Gold's Pen](https://dflamezshotz.com/blog): Articles about photography, creativity, and visual storytelling.
